'''Silya Shessaun''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who served as a [[senator]] in the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Galactic Senate|senate]] during the [[Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. She was an ally of Senator [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] of the [[planet]] [[Naboo]] and attended her [[Padmé Amidala's funeral|funeral]].<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Silya Shessaun was a character originally intended to appear in the film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] portrayed by publicity assistant [[Lisa Shaunessy]], but her scenes did not make it into the final cut of the film. The name "Silya Shessaun" is [[Tuckerization|derived]] from an anagram of Shaunessy's name<ref name="blog">{{Blog|hedecga|5|Silya Shessaun: In-Depth}}</ref> and was originally revealed in a blog post on the [[StarWars.com]] blog made on [[December 8]], [[2004]].<ref name="Caught on Cam">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/bts/profile/f20041208/index.html|text=Caught on the Cam: Lisa Shaunessy}}</ref> The character was confirmed to be [[canon]] by the reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'', which was written by [[Adam Bray]], [[Tricia Barr]] and [[Cole Horton]]<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> and released on [[April 4]], [[2017]].<ref name="Release date">{{SW|url=news/new-galaxy-guides-get-a-first-look-at-dks-star-wars-visual-encyclopedia-and-the-amazing-book-of-lego-star-wars|text=New Galaxy Guides: Get a First Look at DK's ''Star Wars Visual Encyclopedia'' and ''The Amazing Book of LEGO Star Wars''}}</ref>
